title: Attorney General, Solicitor General, Advocate General
quote: Only the AG is created by the Constitution; SG and ASGs are statutory

head: Basis
Attorney General
Solicitor General
Advocate General

boxes.title: Attorney General (Art. 76)
items: ==**Highest / first law officer**== of India; chief legal adviser to GoI
**No fixed tenure**; removal procedure/grounds not specified
Remuneration by **President**; not charged on Consolidated Fund
**Not a member** of the Union Cabinet
Resigns traditionally when Council of Ministers changes

boxes.title: AG duties
steps: Advise GoI on legal matters referred by **President** (via **Ministry of Law**)
Appear for GoI in all **Supreme Court** cases
Appear in any High Court when required

boxes.title: SG & ASGs
items: SG = **second law officer**; **3-year term**; assisted by ASGs
Appears in courts + tenders legal advice
AG & SG: ex officio members of **Bar Council of India** (Advocates Act, **1961**)

boxes.title: Advocate General (Art. 165)
items: First law officer of a **state**; appointed by **Governor** (Art. 165(1))
Pleasure of Governor (**Art. 165(3)**); ⚠ not of State Cabinet / CM
**Art. 177**: speak in state legislature; ==**no right to vote**==

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Highest law officer = ==**AG**== (not CJI, not Law Minister) - APPSC 2018, 2019
HC judges appointed by **President**; Advocate General by **Governor**
⚠ Trap: Constitution does not govern SG/ASGs
